text:
Oscillation dies at vctrl = 0.7 V, so f_lo can't be measured and swing reads about 0 V. f_mid (3.48 GHz) and power (0.32 mW) already pass.

The likely cause is the floor resistors. When the PMOS starvers turn off at low control voltage, the resistors degenerate the inverter sources. This collapses loop gain at the operating point the simulation starts from, so the ring doesn't start up.

Changes in the new program:
- **Floor resistors removed.** Small decaps go on the starved supply rails (pa/na) so the inverter sources act as AC ground. This keeps loop gain high at low current.
- **Low-end bias set by the divider.** The divider places vcn near the NMOS threshold at vctrl = 0.7 V, giving roughly 6 µA and an f_lo near 150 MHz. That keeps the tuning ratio above 29 against the measured f_hi of 5.7 GHz.
- **Startup kick.** A small asymmetric capacitor on one ring node breaks the symmetric DC solution so the ring starts.
- **Model recalibrated.** Frequency gain KCAL ≈ 2.5 and a power correction factor, both fitted to the last simulation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Ring doesn't oscillate at 0.7 V: floor resistors degenerate inverter sources when PMOS starvers turn off, killing startup. Remove them, add rail decaps and an asymmetry kick, set divider so vcn≈Vth at 0.7 V (f_lo≈150 MHz), recalibrate f/power model."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn_inv": (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),    # ring inverter NMOS width (L=0.15)
    "Wp_inv": (1.2, 0.42, 4.0),    # ring inverter PMOS width (L=0.15)
    "Ws_n":   (5.0, 1.0, 16.0),    # NMOS starving device width
    "Ws_p":   (12.0, 2.0, 40.0),   # PMOS starving device width
    "Ls":     (0.2, 0.15, 0.6),    # starving/mirror channel length
    "kref":   (6.0, 2.0, 12.0),    # starver/reference mirror ratio
    "Wbuf":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),     # final buffer NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cdec":   (30e-15, 5e-15, 200e-15),  # decap on starved rails (AC ground for inverter sources)
    "adiv":   (0.72, 0.55, 0.95),  # divider ratio vcn = adiv*vctrl
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 3
    Li = 0.15
    Wn, Wp = p["Wn_inv"], p["Wp_inv"]
    Wsn, Wsp, Ls, k = p["Ws_n"], p["Ws_p"], p["Ls"], p["kref"]
    Wb = p["Wbuf"]
    Cd = p["Cdec"]
    a = p["adiv"]
    Rd = 200e3
    Wrn, Wrp = max(0.42, Wsn / k), max(0.42, Wsp / k)
    k_eff_p = Wsp / Wrp

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # control level-shift divider (gate-only load) + decoupling
    n.R("RD1", "vctrl", "vcn", Rd * (1 - a))
    n.R("RD2", "vcn", "vss", Rd * a)
    n.C("CDN", "vcn", "vss", 2e-12)
    # reference branch: NMOS on vcn -> diode PMOS generates vbp
    n.M("MRN", "vbp", "vcn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wrn, Ls)
    n.M("MRP", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wrp, Ls)
    n.C("CDP", "vbp", "vdd", 1e-12)
    for i in range(N):
        ai, y = f"x{i}", f"x{(i + 1) % N}"
        n.M(f"MSP{i}", f"pa{i}", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wsp, Ls)
        n.C(f"CPA{i}", f"pa{i}", "vss", Cd)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, ai, f"pa{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, ai, f"na{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.M(f"MSN{i}", f"na{i}", "vcn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wsn, Ls)
        n.C(f"CNA{i}", f"na{i}", "vss", Cd)
    # symmetry break / start-up kick (couples supply ramp into one node)
    n.C("CKICK", "x1", "vdd", 2e-15)
    Wb1 = max(0.42, Wb / 3)
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "x0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wb1, Li)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "x0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb1, Li)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wb, Li)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Li)

    def cg(dev, W, L):
        try:
            return abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"])
        except Exception:
            return 1.5e-15 * W
    c_gate = cg("n", Wn, Li) + cg("p", Wp, Li)
    c_drain = 0.6 * c_gate
    C = c_gate + c_drain + 1e-15
    C0 = C + cg("n", Wb1, Li) + cg("p", 2 * Wb1, Li)
    Cavg = (2 * C + C0 + 2e-15) / 3
    KCAL = 2.5   # calibrated against previous simulation (sim/pred ~2.75 at mid)

    def istarve(vc):
        vg = a * vc
        In = abs(lut.op("n", Wsn, Ls, vg, 0.6)["Id"])
        Iref = abs(lut.op("n", Wrn, Ls, vg, 0.6)["Id"])
        Ip = Iref * k_eff_p
        return min(In, Ip), Iref

    Iinv = min(abs(lut.op("n", Wn, Li, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]),
               abs(lut.op("p", Wp, Li, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]))
    f_ceil = 1.4 * Iinv / (N * Cavg * VDD)

    fs, irefs = [], []
    for vc in (0.7, 1.05, 1.4):
        I, Ir = istarve(vc)
        f_st = KCAL * I / (N * Cavg * VDD)
        fs.append(1.0 / (1.0 / max(f_st, 1.0) + 1.0 / f_ceil))
        irefs.append(Ir)
    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = fs

    Cb = cg("n", Wb, Li) + cg("p", 2 * Wb, Li)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 10e-15) if isinstance(spec, dict) else 10e-15
    p_ring = N * Cavg * VDD**2 * f_mid
    p_buf = (Cb * 1.6 + CL + 3 * cg("n", Wb, Li)) * VDD**2 * f_mid
    p_ref = irefs[1] * VDD
    p_div = VDD * 1.05 / Rd
    power = 2.0 * (p_ring + p_buf) + p_ref + p_div

    return n, {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / 0.7,
        "swing": 1.7,
        "power": power,
    }
```
